title: A Batman Game Trailer That’s Basically a Love Letter to a 90s Song
summary: Have you ever heard a song in a video game trailer and thought, “Wait, that’s perfect!”? That’s exactly what happened with the new Lego Batman: Legacy of the Dark Knight trailer. It uses Seal’s “Kiss from a Rose,” a song from the 1995 movie Batman Forever. And honestly? It’s so good it might be the best trailer of the year. The game itself is a huge open-world Batman adventure made of Lego bricks. It’s like the Arkham games, but sillier and full of plastic blocks. You can explore Gotham, fight bad guys, and unlock tons of costumes and vehicles from Batman’s 80-year history. The trailer isn’t just a random music choice. It’s a clever nod to Batman’s past. “Kiss from a Rose” first appeared in The NeverEnding Story III, but it became a mega-hit when it was used in Batman Forever. Including it shows how the game blends together all kinds of Batman stuff — from comics to movies to old video games. There’s even a joke about how actor Tommy Lee Jones didn’t like Jim Carrey on the set of Batman Forever. Most kids won’t get that reference, but grown-up Lego and Batman fans will love it. And that’s okay! The game is for everyone. Lego Batman: Legacy of the Dark Knight comes out on May 22 for PS5, Xbox Series X/S, and PC. A Nintendo Switch 2 version is coming later. So grab your bricks and get ready to build some justice!
why_it_matters: It shows how an old song can suddenly feel new again and make a video game trailer unforgettable, just like how your favorite soundtrack can make a movie or game special to you.

background_read: "Kiss from a Rose" by Seal (a British singer who won Grammy Awards for this song) was first released in 1994 but became a worldwide hit after being included in the 1995 movie Batman Forever.

The Lego Batman video games have been making kids and adults laugh since 2008. They mix serious superhero stories with the silly charm of Lego bricks, allowing players to build, smash, and explore famous locations like Gotham City.
Article_Structure: WHO: The makers of the Lego Batman video game trailer
WHAT: Used an old hit song, Seal’s “Kiss from a Rose,” to create a nostalgic trailer full of Batman history
WHERE: In the trailer for the upcoming game Lego Batman: Legacy of the Dark Knight
WHY: To honor Batman’s long history and make fans of the 1995 movie Batman Forever feel excited

perspectives.description: People who grew up loving Batman Forever and the song will feel a rush of happy memories and think the trailer is a brilliant love letter to Batman’s past.
Many kids won’t understand the old jokes or the song’s history, but the game still offers enough silly Lego action and characters to keep them entertained.
The trailer cleverly catches the attention of both adults and children by mixing ironic humor with a widely recognized pop song, which may help the game sell well.
